delivery_review_evidence.interpretation: Observed association only; not a causal estimate.

grain_contract.reason: Prevent item x payment x review fanout from inflating monetary measures.

evidence_policy: Only figures reproduced from the pinned Olist v7 source and the complete-month commercial window are promoted to README/CV claims. Synthetic fixtures are used only for software and SQL-grain tests.
limitations: Historical anonymised marketplace data; the results do not describe Olist's current business.
Merchandise value is not profit because product cost and operating expense are unavailable.
Delivery and review relationships are observational and should not be interpreted as causal effects.
Later acquisition cohorts have less time to mature and are right-censored.
